value.text: In October 2026, while serving as vice chair of the Super Intelligence Force, Scott Kupor said the obligation is to demonstrate to the American people that AI is good while taking their anxieties and concerns seriously. He described the committee’s purpose as identifying a comprehensive set of policies to meet the President’s dual goals and said the aim is to keep winning while doing so responsibly.
